svg.title: Dossiya Dakou — physics-grounded mathematical engineering
svg.desc: Publication-style research portrait. Power uses red, Transportation green, Information blue and Organization amber. Causal mechanisms use ochre, model geometry uses violet, viability uses green, and critical boundaries use dashed red. Color is never the sole encoding.
svg.text: Physics-grounded mathematical engineering for sustainable infrastructure

g.text: green physical path · blue dashed information relation

svg.text: vector field · level sets · critical boundary · resilience margin · admissible control
violet = mathematical model · cyan = state/inference · green = viable · dashed red = critical · gold = intervention
current research transition · Causal Mechanisms → Coupled Hybrid Multiscale Dynamics
Mathematical art is explanatory: motion is not a measured flow, level sets are not fitted telemetry, and RGB does not increase evidence strength.
